steps.caption: Open Buildings from the sidebar, then the Supply tab.
The rule at the top: lease expiry and future supply are never shown as vacancy.
Three views: Inventory (this one), Operators for managed offices and coworking, and Match for a client requirement.
The yellow line counts stale observations — reconfirm them before presenting to a client.
Each row: the building, floor and unit, category and contiguous block.
Harbour Point floor 4 is Immediately available, verified this week from a landlord email: high confidence.
Floor 5 is Future availability from April 2027 — it is not counted as available today.
Floor 6 is Occupied: confidence none, so it is never offered.
Other statuses include under offer, leased, withdrawn and unconfirmed. Unknown CAM shows as unknown — never zero.
Source and verified: where the information came from and when it was last checked. 'Never verified' rows have low confidence.
Click a building to open it and see all its spaces.
